newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AKZO NOBEL TO BUILD DANISH POWER PLANT.
newsitem.headline: AKZO NOBEL TO BUILD DANISH POWER PLANT.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Wednesday its Danish unit Dansk Salt A/S would build a natural gas fired cogeneration plant, which required an investment of about 200 million Danish crowns.
The plant will produce the steam which is required for the salt factory's evaporation installations.

Electricity capacity of the combined heat and power plant, which will be based at Mariager, is estimated at 29 MW, equal to the electricity consumption of 60,000 households. Surplus production will be delivered to the public grid, Akzo Nobel said.
The Dutch group added that the project implied another step towards a more efficient energy utilisation and reducing sulfur dioxide and carbon dioxide emissions.
Dansk Salt is the main supplier of salt for domestic use, the food sector and chemical industries in Scandinavia. It has annual production capacity of about 600,000 tonnes.
